- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for 30-day horizon.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes — add 3–7% to forecast if sentiment drops below -0.50 in last 5 days.
- Overshoot after recent price spikes — cap forecast at 10% below peak of last 7-day range.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast > 1.5x recent 14-day average, reduce by 15–20%.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment was positive 3–5 days ago, forecast should be 2–3% lower than model output.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate early in downturns — apply 5–8% downward adjustment if sentiment < -0.40 for last 7 days.
